rendered: The variant that retained the most capacity is NFA-A, which maintained ≈80% capacity after[1] 100 cycles when compared with the NFA 811 (≈70%)[2] at C/3. NFA-F was lower, at (≈50%)[3] retention. Its composition is LiNi0.8Fe0.05Al0.15O2[4], so its iron and aluminium contents are the Fe and Al subscripts of that formula. The text states its aluminium content as 15% Al[5]. The table Table 1[6] does not use the variant name for this composition; its row for the higher-aluminium variant is labelled Al-rich NFA, and that row gives a c lattice parameter of 14.2232(4)[7].
